true_false.question_en: The growth of IoT devices is one of the main causes of the data explosion.
true_false.question_ar: هل نمو أجهزة إنترنت الأشياء هو أحد الأسباب الرئيسية لانفجار البيانات؟
true_false.explanation: IoT devices continuously generate massive amounts of data, contributing to data explosion.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best describes a coordinate frame?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يصف إطار الإحداثيات (Coordinate Frame) بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: A random set of lines used only for drawing robots
options.b: A right-handed system of orthogonal axes intersecting at an origin, used to describe the environment and motion
options.c: A sensor used to measure robot velocity
options.d: A matrix used only for rotation

mcq.explanation: A coordinate frame is a right-handed orthogonal coordinate system used to represent positions, orientations, and motion.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following is an example of a fixed coordinate frame?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يُعد مثالاً على إطار إحداثيات ثابت؟

options.a: Body frame {B} attached to the vehicle
options.b: Sensor frame attached to the sensor
options.c: World frame {W}
options.d: End-effector frame attached to the robot tool

mcq.explanation: The world frame is typically fixed and serves as the global reference frame.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following is an example of a moving coordinate frame?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يُعد مثالاً على إطار إحداثيات متحرك؟

options.a: Reference frame {0}
options.b: World frame {W}
options.c: Body frame {B} attached to the vehicle

mcq.explanation: The body frame moves with the vehicle and therefore changes its position and orientation over time.

mcq.question_en: How can a satellite determine its position relative to the Earth?
mcq.question_ar: كيف يمكن للقمر الصناعي تحديد موقعه بالنسبة للأرض؟

options.a: By measuring only its speed
options.b: By using latitude, longitude, and altitude based on Earth reference lines
options.c: By rotating around its own axes only
options.d: By using only the equator without any other reference

mcq.explanation: Satellite position is commonly described using latitude, longitude, and altitude relative to Earth.

mcq.question_en: What does the term pose represent in robotics?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا يمثل مصطلح Pose في الروبوتات؟

options.a: Only the position of an object in space
options.b: Only the orientation of an object
options.c: The combination of position and orientation of an object

mcq.explanation: Pose describes both the position and orientation of an object in space.

mcq.question_en: What does a point represent?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا تمثل النقطة (Point)؟

options.a: A direction of motion
options.b: A force applied on an object
options.c: A location in space

mcq.explanation: A point specifies a location in space without indicating direction or magnitude.

mcq.question_en: What does a vector represent?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا يمثل المتجه (Vector)؟

options.a: A fixed location only
options.b: A motion or displacement
options.c: A scalar value with no direction

mcq.explanation: A vector represents a quantity with both magnitude and direction, such as displacement.

mcq.question_en: Given the rotation matrix R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]], what does the first column [[[1],[0],[0]]] represent?
mcq.question_ar: إذا كانت مصفوفة الدوران R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]]، فماذا يمثل العمود الأول [[[1],[0],[0]]]؟

options.a: The direction of the new x-axis expressed in the current frame
options.b: The direction of the new y-axis expressed in the current frame
options.c: The direction of the new z-axis expressed in the current frame

mcq.explanation: The first column of a rotation matrix represents the new x-axis expressed in the original frame.

mcq.question_en: Given the rotation matrix R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]], what does the second column [[[0],[0],[1]]] represent?
mcq.question_ar: إذا كانت مصفوفة الدوران R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]]، فماذا يمثل العمود الثاني [[[0],[0],[1]]]؟

options.a: The direction of the new x-axis expressed in the current frame
options.b: The direction of the new y-axis expressed in the current frame
options.c: The direction of the new z-axis expressed in the current frame

mcq.explanation: The second column of a rotation matrix represents the new y-axis expressed in the original frame.

mcq.question_en: Given the rotation matrix R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]], what does the third column [[[0],[-1],[0]]] represent?
mcq.question_ar: إذا كانت مصفوفة الدوران R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]]، فماذا يمثل العمود الثالث [[[0],[-1],[0]]]؟

options.a: The direction of the new x-axis expressed in the current frame
options.b: The direction of the new y-axis expressed in the current frame
options.c: The direction of the new z-axis expressed in the current frame

mcq.explanation: The third column of a rotation matrix represents the new z-axis expressed in the original frame.

mcq.question_en: Using the matrix R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]], what is the direction of the new y-axis?
mcq.question_ar: باستخدام المصفوفة R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]]، ما اتجاه المحور y الجديد؟

options.a: Along -z
options.b: Along +z
options.c: Along +y

mcq.explanation: The second column is [0,0,1]^T, which points along the positive z-axis.

mcq.question_en: Using the matrix R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]], what is the direction of the new z-axis?
mcq.question_ar: باستخدام المصفوفة R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]]، ما اتجاه المحور z الجديد؟

options.a: Along +z
options.b: Along +y
options.c: Along -y

mcq.explanation: The third column is [0,-1,0]^T, which points along the negative y-axis.

mcq.question_en: Given the rotation matrix R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]], what is the direction of the new x-axis?
mcq.question_ar: إذا كانت مصفوفة الدوران R = [[[1,0,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0]]]، فما اتجاه المحور x الجديد؟

options.a: Along +x
options.b: Along +y
options.c: Along +z

mcq.explanation: The first column is [1,0,0]^T, which points along the positive x-axis.

mcq.question_en: What does the notation AξB mean in robotics?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا يعني الترميز AξB في الروبوتات؟

options.a: The pose of frame A described with respect to frame B only by translation
options.b: The pose of frame B described with respect to frame A, using rotation and translation
options.c: The velocity of frame B with respect to frame A
options.d: The distance between frame A and frame B only

mcq.explanation: AξB represents the pose of frame B relative to frame A, including both rotation and translation.

mcq.question_en: In the notation AξB, which frame is the reference frame?
mcq.question_ar: في الترميز AξB، أي إطار يُعد الإطار المرجعي؟

options.a: Frame B
options.b: Frame A
options.c: Both frames A and B

mcq.explanation: Frame A is the reference frame in which frame B is described.

mcq.question_en: To define AξB, we usually describe it using:
mcq.question_ar: لتعريف AξB عادةً ما نستخدم:

options.a: Velocity and acceleration
options.b: Position and force
options.c: Rotation and translation

mcq.explanation: A pose is defined by a rotation component and a translation component.

mcq.question_en: What does the rotation matrix ARB do?
mcq.question_ar: ما وظيفة مصفوفة الدوران ARB؟

options.a: It converts a vector from frame A to frame B
options.b: It transforms a coordinate vector defined with respect to frame B into a coordinate vector with respect to frame A
options.c: It gives the distance between frame A and frame B
options.d: It only describes translation between the two frames

mcq.explanation: The rotation matrix transforms vector coordinates from frame B into frame A.

mcq.question_en: The rotation matrix used to describe the orientation of frame {B} with respect to frame {A} is:
mcq.question_ar: ما أبعاد مصفوفة الدوران المستخدمة لوصف اتجاه الإطار {B} بالنسبة للإطار {A}؟
mcq.explanation: In 3D space, rotation is represented by a 3×3 orthogonal rotation matrix.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best describes intrinsic rotation?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يصف الدوران الداخلي (Intrinsic Rotation) بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: Rotation about the fixed world axes, while the axes stay unchanged
options.b: Rotation about the body's own moving axes, where the axes rotate after each step
options.c: Rotation only about the z-axis

mcq.explanation: Intrinsic rotations are performed about the object's local axes, which change orientation after each rotation.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best describes extrinsic rotation?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يصف الدوران الخارجي (Extrinsic Rotation) بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: Rotation about the body's own moving axes
options.b: Rotation where the frame moves with the object
options.c: Rotation about the fixed world axes, where the axes do not move

mcq.explanation: Extrinsic rotations are performed about fixed reference axes that do not change during the sequence.

mcq.question_en: In Euler's rotation, the roll, pitch, and yaw angles are denoted respectively by:
mcq.question_ar: في دوران أويلر (Euler Rotation)، يتم تمثيل زوايا Roll و Pitch و Yaw على الترتيب بالرموز:

options.a: α, β, γ
options.b: x, y, z
options.c: a, b, c

mcq.explanation: Euler angles are commonly represented by α (roll), β (pitch), and γ (yaw).

mcq.question_en: What is the main purpose of a homogeneous transformation matrix in robotics?
mcq.question_ar: ما الغرض الرئيسي من مصفوفة التحويل المتجانس (Homogeneous Transformation Matrix) في الروبوتات؟

options.a: To describe only the rotation of a frame
options.b: To describe only the translation of a frame
options.c: To combine rotation and translation in one matrix

mcq.explanation: A homogeneous transformation matrix combines both rotation and translation into a single representation.

mcq.question_en: A homogeneous transformation matrix in 3D is usually:
mcq.question_ar: ما الأبعاد المعتادة لمصفوفة التحويل المتجانس في الفضاء ثلاثي الأبعاد؟
mcq.explanation: In 3D robotics, homogeneous transformations are represented using a 4×4 matrix.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best defines an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU)?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يعرّف وحدة القياس بالقصور الذاتي (IMU) بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: A device that uses GPS signals to determine robot position only
options.b: A system that uses onboard sensors to estimate orientation, velocity, and position without external signals
options.c: A sensor used only to measure temperature and pressure
options.d: A camera system used for visual navigation

mcq.explanation: An IMU uses internal sensors such as accelerometers and gyroscopes to estimate motion states without relying on external references.

mcq.question_en: An IMU typically consists of sensors that measure which of the following?
mcq.question_ar: تتكون وحدة IMU عادةً من مستشعرات تقيس أي مما يلي؟

options.a: Temperature, humidity, and pressure
options.b: Distance, speed, and color
options.c: Accelerations, angular velocities, and magnetic flux density

mcq.explanation: An IMU commonly includes accelerometers, gyroscopes, and magnetometers.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best describes an Inertial Navigation System (INS)?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يصف نظام الملاحة بالقصور الذاتي (INS) بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: A system that relies on GPS signals to determine position only
options.b: A system that estimates velocity, orientation, and position by processing raw data from IMU sensors
options.c: A device used only to measure acceleration
options.d: A communication system for radio navigation

mcq.explanation: An INS processes IMU measurements to estimate orientation, velocity, and position.

mcq.question_en: What is meant by bias in INS sensor errors?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا يُقصد بالانحياز (Bias) في أخطاء مستشعرات INS؟

options.a: The sensor gives completely random values
options.b: The sensor always reads a small constant error even when there is no motion
options.c: The sensor stops working after some time
options.d: The sensor only works at high speeds

mcq.explanation: Bias is a constant offset error that exists even when the true input is zero.

mcq.question_en: What is drift in an Inertial Navigation System (INS)?
mcq.question_ar: ما المقصود بالانجراف (Drift) في نظام الملاحة بالقصور الذاتي (INS)؟

options.a: A sudden large error in measurement
options.b: Errors that cancel each other over time
options.c: Small errors that accumulate over time causing the estimate to move away from the true value
options.d: Errors caused only by external signals

mcq.explanation: Drift occurs because small measurement errors are integrated repeatedly, causing increasing deviation from the true state.

mcq.question_en: What is the main purpose of calibration in an IMU system?
mcq.question_ar: ما الهدف الرئيسي من معايرة (Calibration) نظام IMU؟

options.a: To increase the size of the sensor
options.b: To teach the sensor what zero and the correct scale should be
options.c: To connect the IMU to GPS satellites

mcq.explanation: Calibration removes offsets and scale-factor errors to improve measurement accuracy.

mcq.question_en: What is meant by alignment in an IMU system?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا يُقصد بالمحاذاة (Alignment) في نظام IMU؟

options.a: Matching the IMU axes correctly with the vehicle or robot axes
options.b: Increasing the sensor battery life
options.c: Reducing the robot speed
options.d: Changing the link lengths of the robot

mcq.explanation: Alignment ensures that the IMU coordinate axes correspond correctly to the vehicle or robot coordinate axes.

mcq.question_en: Why can a small sensor error become a large error in an Inertial Navigation System (INS)?
mcq.question_ar: لماذا يمكن أن يتحول خطأ صغير في المستشعر إلى خطأ كبير في نظام INS؟

options.a: Because the INS ignores acceleration data
options.b: Because the INS repeatedly integrates measurements, so small errors accumulate and grow over time
options.c: Because the INS uses only external signals
options.d: Because the IMU measures position directly

mcq.explanation: Repeated integration of noisy measurements causes small errors to accumulate and become significant over time.

mcq.question_en: What is the purpose of sensor fusion in INS?
mcq.question_ar: ما الهدف من دمج المستشعرات (Sensor Fusion) في نظام INS؟

options.a: To replace all sensors with one IMU
options.b: To combine the IMU with other sensors to correct errors and reduce drift
options.c: To increase the robot weight

mcq.explanation: Sensor fusion combines information from multiple sensors, such as IMU and GPS, to improve accuracy and reduce drift.

mcq.question_en: Why is periodic calibration important in INS systems?
mcq.question_ar: لماذا تعتبر المعايرة الدورية مهمة في أنظمة INS؟

options.a: Because the robot joints become longer over time
options.b: Because environment and temperature changes can affect sensor accuracy
options.c: Because GPS always stops working indoors

mcq.explanation: Environmental conditions and temperature variations can introduce sensor errors, making periodic calibration necessary.

mcq.question_en: What is the role of error correction algorithms in INS?
mcq.question_ar: ما دور خوارزميات تصحيح الأخطاء في أنظمة INS؟

options.a: They estimate and subtract bias, detect bad measurements, and keep the system stable
options.b: They only increase the sensor output values
options.c: They replace all navigation sensors
options.d: They control only the robot motors

mcq.explanation: Error correction algorithms reduce bias, identify faulty measurements, and improve navigation stability.

mcq.question_en: In the gyroscope-based INS orientation update equation R(k+1) = R(k)e^(Δt(ωB)×), what does this equation mean?
mcq.question_ar: في معادلة تحديث الاتجاه المعتمدة على الجيروسكوب R(k+1) = R(k)e^(Δt(ωB)×)، ماذا تعني هذه المعادلة؟

options.a: New orientation = angular velocity × time only
options.b: New orientation = old orientation × small rotation obtained from gyro data during Δt
options.c: New orientation = position + velocity + acceleration
options.d: New orientation = GPS measurement corrected by the gyroscope

mcq.explanation: The new orientation is obtained by applying the incremental rotation measured by the gyroscope to the previous orientation.

mcq.question_en: An accelerometer measures the quantity a# = a + g. What does this equation mean?
mcq.question_ar: يقيس مقياس التسارع الكمية a# = a + g. ماذا تعني هذه المعادلة؟

options.a: The accelerometer measures only the robot's motion acceleration
options.b: The accelerometer measures only gravity
options.c: The accelerometer reading is the sum of the robot's true acceleration and gravity
options.d: The accelerometer removes gravity from the measurement automatically

mcq.explanation: Accelerometers measure specific force, which includes both motion-related acceleration and gravity.

mcq.question_en: Why do we use sensor fusion in robotics?
mcq.question_ar: لماذا نستخدم دمج المستشعرات (Sensor Fusion) في الروبوتات؟

options.a: To rely on only one sensor for faster computation
options.b: To combine the strengths of different sensors and reduce overall error
options.c: To eliminate the need for sensors completely

mcq.explanation: Sensor fusion combines data from multiple sensors to improve accuracy and robustness.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following sensor fusion methods is more powerful, more accurate, and more mathematically complex?
mcq.question_ar: أي من طرق دمج المستشعرات التالية أكثر قوة ودقة وتعقيدًا رياضيًا؟

options.a: Complementary filter
options.b: Low-pass filter
options.c: Kalman filter (Extended Kalman)

mcq.explanation: The Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is widely used because it provides optimal estimation under many practical conditions.

mcq.question_en: What is a waypoint in robot motion planning?
mcq.question_ar: ما المقصود بـ Waypoint في تخطيط حركة الروبوت؟

options.a: The final destination of the robot only
options.b: An intermediate target that the robot should pass through
options.c: The speed limit of the robot
options.d: A sensor used to detect obstacles

mcq.explanation: A waypoint is an intermediate position used to guide the robot along a desired path.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best defines the Degree of Freedom (DoF) of a robot?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يعرّف درجات الحرية (DoF) للروبوت بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: The total weight of the robot links
options.b: The number of motors used in the robot
options.c: The number of independent parameters needed to fully describe the robot configuration
options.d: The maximum speed of the robot end-effector

mcq.explanation: Degrees of Freedom represent the number of independent variables required to describe a robot's configuration.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following statements is correct about a Revolute joint (R)?
mcq.question_ar: أي العبارات التالية صحيحة بشأن المفصل الدوراني (Revolute Joint - R)؟

options.a: It provides translation motion with variable d
options.b: It provides rotation motion with variable θ and has 1 DoF
options.c: It has 3 DoF and allows full spatial motion
options.d: It does not allow any motion

mcq.explanation: A revolute joint allows rotation about a single axis and contributes one degree of freedom.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following statements is correct about a Prismatic joint (P)?
mcq.question_ar: أي العبارات التالية صحيحة بشأن المفصل الانزلاقي (Prismatic Joint - P)؟

options.a: It provides rotation motion with variable θ
options.b: It provides translation motion with variable d and has 1 DoF
options.c: It has 3 DoF and allows spherical motion
options.d: It connects links without allowing motion

mcq.explanation: A prismatic joint provides linear translation along one axis and has one degree of freedom.

mcq.question_en: What is true about a Spherical joint?
mcq.question_ar: ما العبارة الصحيحة بشأن المفصل الكروي (Spherical Joint)؟

options.a: It has 1 DoF only
options.b: It only provides translation
options.c: It has 3 DoF
options.d: It is the same as a prismatic joint

mcq.explanation: A spherical joint allows rotation about three independent axes and therefore has 3 DoF.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best describes Forward Kinematics (FK)?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يصف الحركيات الأمامية (Forward Kinematics - FK) بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: Finding joint angles from the desired end-effector position
options.b: Calculating the end-effector position from the joint angles and link lengths
options.c: Finding robot velocity from the Jacobian matrix
options.d: Calculating link lengths from the end-effector pose

mcq.explanation: Forward kinematics computes the pose of the end-effector from known joint variables and robot geometry.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following best describes Inverse Kinematics (IK)?
mcq.question_ar: أي مما يلي يصف الحركيات العكسية (Inverse Kinematics - IK) بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: Calculating the end-effector pose from the joint variables
options.b: Finding link lengths from the robot position
options.c: Finding the joint variables needed to reach a desired end-effector pose
options.d: Calculating angular velocity from linear velocity

mcq.explanation: Inverse kinematics determines the required joint values to achieve a specified end-effector pose.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following statements correctly describes the purpose of Denavit–Hartenberg (DH) parameters?
mcq.question_ar: أي العبارات التالية تصف الغرض من معاملات دينافيت-هارتنبرغ (DH) بشكل صحيح؟

options.a: They are used to calculate robot velocities directly from joint speeds
options.b: They provide a standard method to describe each joint/link using four parameters and systematically build the robot forward kinematics
options.c: They are used only for parallel robots to simplify inverse kinematics
options.d: They replace the need for coordinate frames in robot modeling

mcq.explanation: DH parameters provide a standardized way to model robot geometry and derive forward kinematics.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following lists the four Denavit–Hartenberg (DH) parameters correctly?
mcq.question_ar: أي من القوائم التالية تحتوي على معاملات دينافيت-هارتنبرغ الأربعة بشكل صحيح؟

options.a: (θi, di, ai, αi)
options.b: (xi, yi, zi, θi)
options.c: (qi, q̇i, ai, vi)

mcq.explanation: The four DH parameters are joint angle (θ), link offset (d), link length (a), and link twist (α).

mcq.question_en: A robot arm that consists of a chain of links connected one after another, where each joint moves the next link and motion flows from the base to the end-effector is called:
mcq.question_ar: الذراع الروبوتية التي تتكون من سلسلة من الوصلات المتصلة تباعًا بحيث يحرك كل مفصل الوصلة التالية وتنتقل الحركة من القاعدة إلى المؤثر النهائي تسمى:

options.a: Parallel Manipulator
options.b: Mobile Robot
options.c: Serial Manipulator

mcq.explanation: A serial manipulator is composed of links connected in a chain from base to end-effector.

mcq.question_en: A robot mechanism where the end-effector is supported and controlled by multiple arms at the same time in a closed-chain structure is called:
mcq.question_ar: الآلية الروبوتية التي يكون فيها المؤثر النهائي مدعومًا ومتحكمًا به بواسطة عدة أذرع في الوقت نفسه ضمن بنية مغلقة السلسلة تسمى:

options.a: Serial Manipulator
options.b: Wheeled Robot
options.c: Industrial Conveyor Robot

mcq.explanation: A parallel manipulator uses multiple kinematic chains connected to the same end-effector.

mcq.question_en: What is the important advantage of Parallel Manipulators because the load is shared?
mcq.question_ar: ما الميزة المهمة للروبوتات متوازية الحركة (Parallel Manipulators) نتيجة توزيع الحمل؟

options.a: Errors accumulate along the joints
options.b: Lower stiffness and slower motion
options.c: Higher stiffness, better accuracy, and often higher speed
options.d: Motion only comes from one joint

mcq.explanation: Load sharing improves rigidity, accuracy, and dynamic performance.

mcq.question_en: What is the important effect of Serial Manipulators due to their chain-like structure?
mcq.question_ar: ما التأثير المهم للروبوتات التسلسلية (Serial Manipulators) نتيجة بنيتها الشبيهة بالسلسلة؟

options.a: The load is shared between multiple arms
options.b: Errors accumulate along the joints leading to a larger error at the end-effector
options.c: The robot becomes faster and more accurate
options.d: The structure becomes stiffer with less bending

mcq.explanation: Small errors in each joint can accumulate and cause significant end-effector error.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following represents the correct order of the steps for solving Inverse Kinematics?
mcq.question_ar: أي من التالي يمثل الترتيب الصحيح لخطوات حل الحركيات العكسية (Inverse Kinematics)؟

options.a: Find the joint angles → Know the robot dimensions → Know the target pose → Move the robot
options.b: Know the robot dimensions → Know the target pose → Find the joint angles → Move the robot
options.c: Know the target pose → Know the robot dimensions → Find the joint angles → Move the robot
options.d: Know the target pose → Find the joint angles → Know the robot dimensions → Move the robot

mcq.explanation: Robot geometry is known first, then the target pose is specified, IK is solved, and finally the robot is commanded.

mcq.question_en: Which statement best describes the analytical solution for inverse kinematics?
mcq.question_ar: أي عبارة تصف الحل التحليلي (Analytical Solution) للحركيات العكسية بشكل أفضل؟

options.a: Using repeated calculations step by step until reaching the correct answer
options.b: Using geometry or algebra to obtain direct equations for the joint angles
options.c: Using trial-and-error motion of the robot joints
options.d: Using sensor feedback to estimate the robot position

mcq.explanation: Analytical solutions derive explicit equations for joint variables using geometry and algebra.

mcq.question_en: What characterizes the numerical solution for inverse kinematics?
mcq.question_ar: ما الذي يميز الحل العددي (Numerical Solution) للحركيات العكسية؟

options.a: Using geometry formulas to get direct joint angle equations
options.b: Solving the problem only once using exact equations
options.c: Using iterative computations that gradually approach the desired solution

mcq.explanation: Numerical methods use iterative optimization or approximation techniques to find a solution.

mcq.question_en: What does Kinematics study in robotics?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا تدرس الحركيات (Kinematics) في الروبوتات؟

options.a: The relationship between robot mass and acceleration
options.b: The relationship between joint variables and robot pose
options.c: The relationship between robot velocity and force
options.d: The relationship between link materials and robot motion

mcq.explanation: Kinematics studies motion and configuration without considering forces.

mcq.question_en: What does Differential Kinematics study?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا تدرس الحركيات التفاضلية (Differential Kinematics)؟

options.a: The relationship between robot structure and link lengths
options.b: The relationship between joint velocities and end-effector velocity
options.c: The relationship between robot position and joint torque
options.d: The relationship between link mass and robot speed

mcq.explanation: Differential kinematics relates joint rates to end-effector velocity through the Jacobian.

mcq.question_en: In robotics, what does Pose describe?
mcq.question_ar: في الروبوتات، ماذا يصف الـ Pose؟

options.a: The speed of the robot joints
options.b: The direction of robot forces
options.c: The position and orientation of the robot
options.d: The torque applied to the joints

mcq.explanation: Pose is the combination of position and orientation.

mcq.question_en: What does Velocity indicate in robot motion?
mcq.question_ar: ماذا تمثل السرعة (Velocity) في حركة الروبوت؟

options.a: Where the robot is located
options.b: How the robot is moving
options.c: The weight of the robot links

mcq.explanation: Velocity describes the rate and direction of motion.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following equations represents Forward Kinematics?
mcq.question_ar: أي من المعادلات التالية تمثل الحركيات الأمامية (Forward Kinematics)؟

options.a: ξE → q
options.b: q → ξE
options.c: q → a

mcq.explanation: Forward kinematics maps joint variables q to the end-effector pose ξE.

mcq.question_en: Which of the following equations represents Inverse Kinematics?
mcq.question_ar: أي من المعادلات التالية تمثل الحركيات العكسية (Inverse Kinematics)؟

options.a: q → ξE
options.b: a → q
options.c: ξE → q

mcq.explanation: Inverse kinematics determines the joint variables required to achieve a desired pose.

mcq.question_en: In differential kinematics, taking the time derivative of the end-effector pose ξ gives ξ̇. What does ξ̇ represent?
mcq.question_ar: في الحركيات التفاضلية، عند اشتقاق وضعية المؤثر النهائي ξ بالنسبة للزمن نحصل على ξ̇. ماذا تمثل ξ̇؟

options.a: The position of the robot joints
options.b: The velocity of the end-effector
options.c: The length of the robot links
options.d: The acceleration of the robot joints

mcq.explanation: The derivative of pose with respect to time represents end-effector velocity.

mcq.question_en: When your arm is fully straight while pushing a door, what happens in terms of robot kinematics?
mcq.question_ar: عندما يكون ذراعك ممدودًا بالكامل أثناء دفع باب، ماذا يحدث من منظور الحركيات الروبوتية؟

options.a: The robot gains additional motion directions
options.b: The robot loses one motion direction
options.c: The robot moves faster in all directions

mcq.explanation: This is a singular configuration where one motion direction is lost.

mcq.question_en: Why does a singularity occur when the arm is fully stretched?
mcq.question_ar: لماذا تحدث حالة التفرد (Singularity) عندما يكون الذراع ممدودًا بالكامل؟

options.a: The joints stop rotating
options.b: The links become aligned in one straight line
options.c: The robot loses power

mcq.explanation: Singularity often occurs when links become collinear, reducing independent motion directions.

mcq.question_en: When the arm is almost straight but not fully, the robot is in:
mcq.question_ar: عندما يكون الذراع شبه مستقيم ولكن ليس بالكامل، يكون الروبوت في حالة:

options.a: Exact singularity
options.b: Near singularity
options.c: Normal configuration

mcq.explanation: The robot is close to a singular configuration and may exhibit poor controllability.

mcq.question_en: What is a typical effect of near singularity?
mcq.question_ar: ما التأثير الشائع لحالة القرب من التفرد (Near Singularity)؟

options.a: The robot cannot move at all
options.b: Small hand motion requires large joint motion
options.c: The robot becomes perfectly controllable

mcq.explanation: Near singularities, small end-effector motions can require very large joint movements.

mcq.question_en: The twist vector is written as:
mcq.question_ar: كيف يُكتب متجه الالتواء (Twist Vector)؟

options.a: V = [x  y]
options.b: V = [v  ω]

mcq.explanation: A twist vector combines linear velocity v and angular velocity ω into a single representation.

mcq.question_en: The translation velocity vector of the end-effector is written as:
mcq.question_ar: يُكتب متجه السرعة الانتقالية للمؤثر النهائي بالشكل:
mcq.explanation: The translational velocity vector consists of the velocity components along x, y, and z.

mcq.question_en: The angular velocity vector is written as:
mcq.question_ar: يُكتب متجه السرعة الزاوية بالشكل:
mcq.explanation: Angular velocity is represented by its components about the x, y, and z axes.

mcq.question_en: The vector v = [[[ẋ],[ẏ],[ż]]] represents:
mcq.question_ar: المتجه v = [[[ẋ],[ẏ],[ż]]] يمثل:

options.a: Position of the robot
options.b: Linear velocity of the end-effector
options.c: Joint angles

mcq.explanation: The vector contains the translational velocity components of the end-effector.

mcq.question_en: The vector ω = [[[ωx],[ωy],[ωz]]] represents:
mcq.question_ar: المتجه ω = [[[ωx],[ωy],[ωz]]] يمثل:

options.a: Linear velocity in x, y, z directions
options.b: Angular velocity around x, y, z axes
options.c: Joint position

mcq.explanation: The vector ω contains angular velocity components around the three coordinate axes.

mcq.question_en: In the vector v = [[[ẋ],[ẏ],[ż]]], what does ẋ represent?
mcq.question_ar: في المتجه v = [[[ẋ],[ẏ],[ż]]]، ماذا تمثل ẋ؟

options.a: Position along x-axis
options.b: Velocity along x-axis
options.c: Rotation around x-axis

mcq.explanation: ẋ denotes the linear velocity component along the x-axis.

short_answer.question_en: Define Big Data in your own words.
short_answer.answer: Big Data refers to extremely large and complex datasets that cannot be efficiently processed using traditional data processing systems. It includes structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data and requires distributed computing systems for storage and analysis.

code.task: 1. Load a dataset and display basic statistical summary (mean, median, std).
code.code:
import pandas as pd

# Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Statistical summary
summary = df.describe()
median = df.median(numeric_only=True)

print('Mean:\n', df.mean(numeric_only=True))
print('Median:\n', median)
print('Std:\n', df.std(numeric_only=True))
